fixed.how: New RuntimeApp.continuations.keepStart(projectId, agentId, {budgetUsdMicro, continues, note}). It runs only when the work's credential rests at its usage limit, nothing is kept and no session of the project runs or waits. It calls noteWait, then keepStartAtReset (KeptStart gains note). POST /sessions calls it after the nothing-runnable check and answers 202 {result: 'kept', startId: '', session: null, sentence: 'A session of X starts at 15:40.'}. No session runs. The wake starts the kept Start once with by 'person', so quiet hours do not hold it; it carries the note. billing.waits.now gives startLabel ('Start at 15:40'), which becomes StartCheckView.blocked.startLabel and the dialog's button. It also gives startsAt (keptStartLine), so the project's status reads 'Starts at 15:40 (your subscription's limit): 1 task'; the rows' line says the same. StartSessionView.result gains 'kept' and sentence (append-only). The dialog's notice is the daemon's sentence. The fake daemon keeps a Start on a startable wait the same way.

notes_for_other_areas: RuntimeApp.preparedContext(projectId) and session/prepared-work.ts preparedContextOf(deps, {agentId, projectId}) return the facts prepareWork decides by. PreparedContext gains continuationWaits, stopped and quiet; RequestWordsContext gains stopped and quiet. requestViews(store, rows, prepared?) takes the reader: pass rt.preparedContext wherever a person reads a card's options.

C6 / d1109-cred-screens: 'Start at 15:40' is built here. Use RuntimeApp.continuations.keepStart(projectId, agentId, {budgetUsdMicro?, continues?, note?}), which returns the sentence or null. It calls noteWait, then keepStartAtReset; KeptStart gains note. POST /sessions answers {result: 'kept', startId: '', session: null, sentence} (StartSessionView.result gains 'kept' and sentence). StartCheckView.blocked.startLabel is the button's words. billing.waits.now returns startLabel while startable and startsAt (credential-wait.ts keptStartLine) while a person Start is kept. project-status's credentialWaitNow.startsAt gives the status line 'Starts at 15:40 (...): N tasks'.

C5 d1109-run-visible: every sentence about the person's waiting continuation names the quiet-hours end when it is later. Helpers: notifications/prefs.ts quietHoursEndAt(quiet, tz, atMs); credential-wait.ts continuationGoesOnAt(human, until) and goesOnAtWords(human, until); waitRowWords takes {goesOnAt, startKept}. Read these instead of recomputing. continuations.waiting already says 'Your session of 10:00 goes on by itself at 17:00.' or 'A session of X starts at 15:40.'.
Event order: a continuation's session now emits session.continues before session.started (its first log line). Code that reads a session's first event must find session.started by type.
d1109-onerepo-join (C4): keptStartOf now also returns Starts kept by POST /sessions during a stop; Make one project should refuse while either waits (as the spec says).
Known gap for later rounds (ADR 0118 Consequences): chat's session.start during a stop is not kept; the cloud runner's inbox-trigger still starts on answers.
